definitions.population: 2022 and 2023 REG PBP. Games/team-games are observed game IDs, not assumed schedule counts. No postseason.
definitions.units: Rates are fractions, not percentages. Every table/row states n; averages also state their nonmissing n. Null means no eligible/known denominator.
definitions.kicks: FG/XP/punts/kickoffs require the attempt flag and play_type != no_play, except a completed XP with an explicit between-downs foul is retained. FG outcomes made/missed/blocked; XP good/failed/blocked. FG bins are inclusive integer yards; outside/missing distance counted separately.
definitions.punts: Rates use all recorded non-nullified punt attempts, blocked included. Gross/net averages exclude blocked punts. Net = kick_distance - return_yards - 20 for a touchback, with both yardage fields known; it is a PBP-derived net, not a penalty-adjusted official punter ledger. Return involvement means a returner ID without touchback, fair catch, downed, OOB or blocked flag; zero-yard/negative returns and muffs count. This proxy is not certified official credited returns.
definitions.kickoffs: Kicking team is defteam (posteam receives). Touchback/return shares use all non-nullified kickoffs. Returns require returner ID and exclude touchback, fair catch, downed, OOB, own recovery and onside. Onside attempts are explicit onside labels in desc; no dedicated onside flag is supplied.
definitions.seasonRules: Historical 2022/2023 populations, not 2026 rule-matched targets. The 2023 inside-25 kickoff fair-catch rule changed this population, and both seasons predate the 2024 dynamic kickoff. Prefer the separate season tables before using pooled team-season ranges.
definitions.fourthDown: Regulation, half_seconds_remaining >120, known preplay margin, excluding Q4 abs(margin)>=17 as garbage time; exclude no_play, kneels and spikes. Observed choices only, not recommended policy. Go conversion uses known fourth_down_converted/failed flags, not assumed success from yardage.
definitions.fourthFieldGrid: yardline_100 measures distance to opponent goal: own1-29=71..99; own30-49=50..70 including midfield (omitted in requested labels); opp49-35=35..49; opp34-20=20..34; redZone=0..19. For this disjoint decision grid, the 20 is assigned to opp34-20; drive red zone separately uses <=20.
definitions.fourthDistanceGrid: ydstogo=1,2,3..5,6..10,11+. Unknown/invalid states excluded with audit counts. All 25 cells retained, including n=0.
definitions.twoPoint: Tries with success/failure outcomes, per all official TDs including defensive/ST TDs. Exclude no_play except explicit fouls enforced between downs, which do not erase the completed try. Associate each try with the most recent same-team TD, using scoring-team margin immediately after its six points, before the try. Margin -15..15 plus outside/unknown rows; unmatched/repeated TD links audited.
definitions.penalties: Accepted enforced description clauses after the last replay reversal; first-penalty columns alone are insufficient. Declined, offsetting and superseded clauses excluded and audited. Team/type/acceptance gaps stay unresolved; other contains known accepted types outside the listed categories. Delay of game combines offensive and defensive labels. Penalties include no_play and special teams.
definitions.drives: One game/fixed_drive/posteam with at least one run/pass/punt/FG possession play (kneels/spikes included, tries excluded); kickoff-only/no-possession groups excluded. Splitting by owner avoids a known fixed_drive merge of two possessions. Outcome is unique provider fixed_drive_result. Offensive points only: owner's TD*6, made FG*3 and subsequent made XP/2pt in the group; defensive/ST returns and safeties do not inflate offensive PPD.
definitions.redZone: Eligible drive with at least one possession-play preplay yardline_100<=20; long TDs without a preplay RZ snap are not trips. TD numerator requires the drive owner to score.
definitions.turnovers: nflfastR interception + fumble_lost row flags on non-nullified, non-try rows. Interceptions credit posteam; fumble flags credit the unique differing-team recovery pair, or a unique known fumbler (covers muffs, repeated same-team fumbles and touchbacks). If both teams explicitly lose a fumble, retain one league row flag but leave team attribution unknown; affected team-season rates are null/excluded from quantiles. This is a provider row-flag reference, not a complete multiple-turnover ledger.
definitions.timeouts: Charged inventory used =3 minus the last known home/away_timeouts_remaining in each regulation half, after ordering by numeric play_id; includes zero-use halves. Missing terminal inventories audited and excluded from known denominator. timeout==1 named-team annotations reported separately: they can include refunded/uncharged fourth timeouts and must not be called charged usage. Overtime excluded.
definitions.ranges: Equal-weight team-season values, separately 32 per season and pooled 64 when nonmissing; linear-interpolated p10/p50/p90. Descriptive variation, not uncertainty intervals, fitted targets or independent play samples. Sparse fourth/margin cells have n but no team-season percentile bands.
